comments: Now a full show (Stan Ward version)
Other version is a partial show, tape missing introduction (and first song?) and possibly three FNC songs, plus the Rory Gallagher archive session.
Tony Wilson has the "worst dose of flu" Tommy has ever heard (on the telephone).
